 We design, build, manage, and maintain infrastructure for our clients. We recruit, reward, and develop our people based on merit, regardless of race, nationality, religion, gender, age, sexual orientation, marital status, or disability. We value our people and treat everyone who works for or with Petrofac fairly and without discrimination.
   

  

 The world is re\-thinking its energy supply and energy security needs and planning for a phased transition to alternative energy sources. We are here to help our clients meet these evolving energy needs.
   

  

 This is an exciting time to join us on this journey.
   

  

***Are you ready to bring the right energy to Petrofac and help us deliver a better future for everyone?***
**JOB TITLE:** 
**IT Lead \- Infrastructure**
**Role Purpose**
 The Infrastructure Lead is accountable for the successful design, delivery and transition of the Petrofac Emirates infrastructure, network and IT operations landscape as part of the Emirates Carve\-Out Programme.
   

  

 The role will provide leadership across the infrastructure workstream, ensuring that all solutions are aligned with the approved Emirates architecture, High Level Design (HLD), security standards and programme guiding principles. The individual will work closely with business, technical, security, application, procurement and managed service partners to ensure the infrastructure platform is delivered within agreed timelines, supports Day 1 operational readiness and enables a successful TSA exit.
   

  

**Key Accountabilities**
**Infrastructure Strategy \& Architecture**
* Own the infrastructure workstream across network, cloud, operational tooling and managed services for the new Petrofac Emirates.
* Ensure all infrastructure decisions align with the approved Emirates HLD, target architecture and programme guiding principles.
* Act as the primary infrastructure technical authority within the programme, reviewing designs and challenging deviations from architecture standards.
* Ensure infrastructure solutions remain scalable, secure, supportable and aligned to the future Petrofac Emirates operating model.
* Support design governance and architecture review forums.


**Delivery \& Implementation**
* Lead the delivery of the Emirates infrastructure platform, including cloud infrastructure, networking, connectivity, identity dependencies, monitoring, backup, recovery and operational tooling.
* Ensure all infrastructure activities are delivered in accordance with programme plans, milestones and TSA exit timelines.
* Coordinate internal teams, vendors and managed service providers to achieve successful implementation outcomes.
* Oversee infrastructure testing, service validation, operational readiness and transition into support.
* Proactively identify risks, issues and dependencies that may impact programme delivery.


**Cross\-Workstream Integration**
* Act as the primary infrastructure representative across all Emirates programme workstreams.
* Collaborate closely with Application, ERP, Security, Identity, Data, Procurement and Business Readiness leads to ensure all technical dependencies are understood, managed and delivered.
* Ensure infrastructure services are provisioned in line with application migration schedules and business cutover plans.
* Support integrated planning, sequencing and dependency management across the wider programme.


**Operational Stability \& Risk Management**
* Ensure carve\-out activities do not negatively impact existing Petrofac operational services, users or critical business processes.
* Challenge delivery approaches that introduce unnecessary transition risk or future operational cost burdens.
* Ensure robust operational readiness, support processes and service management controls are established prior to go\-live.
* Ensure robust compliance with Information and Cybersecurity standards and directives


**Commercial \& Vendor Management**
* Work closely with Procurement and Commercial teams to support infrastructure\-related vendor selection, contracting and mobilisation activities.
* Manage infrastructure delivery partners and suppliers against agreed scope, timelines and quality expectations.
* Review technical proposals and commercial options to ensure alignment with programme objectives and architecture standards.
* Monitor vendor performance, deliverables and issue resolution throughout the lifecycle of the programme.


**Governance \& Reporting**
* Input to RAID Logs and status updates to the Programme Director and Steering Committee.
* Escalate key risks, decisions and dependencies in a timely manner.
* Support executive reporting and governance forums as required.


**Experience \& Qualifications**
* 10\+ years' experience leading enterprise infrastructure, network or cloud transformation programmes.
* Proven experience delivering complex infrastructure initiatives.
* Strong understanding of cloud infrastructure, networking, IT operations, service management and managed service operating models.
* Experience managing system integrators, outsourcing providers and technology partners.
* Strong stakeholder management skills across technical, business and executive audiences.
* Demonstrated experience managing delivery across multiple interdependent workstreams.
* Experience within engineering, construction, EPC, energy or industrial sectors.
* Desirable
* Formal programme or project management qualifications (PMP, PRINCE2, MSP or equivalent).
* Critical Success Measures
* Infrastructure delivery achieved in line with programme milestones and TSA exit dates.
* Full compliance with Emirates HLD and architecture standards.
* Successful Day 1 operational readiness and business continuity.
* No material disruption to RemainingCo services or operations.
* Effective management of cross\-workstream dependencies.
* Infrastructure platform transitioned successfully into steady\-state operations.

**Required Skills \& Competencies**

* Ownership and accountability: proactive risk management, transparent communication.


**Qualifications**
* 6–10\+ years in Client\-Facing Technical roles (e.g., Solutions Architect, Pre\-Sales Engineer, AI Consultant).

* Bachelor’s/Master’s in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience.
* Experience in at least one enterprise vertical (e.g., BFSI, Manufacturing, Retail, Healthcare) is a plus.

* Employee experience: HR policy assistant, IT helpdesk copilot, onboarding flows.

**Job Description** 
 – Oracle OCI Exadata Architect
 



**Position** 
 : Oracle OCI Exadata Architect
 



**Experience** 
 : 12\+ Years
 



**Role Level:** 
 Architect / Lead SME
 



**Location**

**Role Overview** 




 We are looking for an experienced Oracle OCI Exadata Architect with strong hands\-on expertise in designing, administering and supporting enterprise Oracle database environments on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI).
 



 The candidate must have strong experience with OCI Exadata Database Service on Dedicated Infrastructure (ExaDB\-D), Exadata VM Clusters, Oracle Database 19c/23ai, RAC, Grid Infrastructure, ASM, Data Guard, RMAN, Exadata patching, performance tuning, OCI networking and disaster recovery.
 



 This is a hands\-on Architect/Lead SME role requiring strong technical leadership and the ability to troubleshoot complex production issues.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




 • Architect, administer and support OCI Exadata Database Service on Dedicated Infrastructure (ExaDB\-D).
 



 • Provision, configure and manage Exadata Infrastructure and Exadata VM Clusters.
 



 • Manage Exadata compute, memory, storage, database servers and storage servers, including capacity planning and resource optimization.
 



 • Plan and execute Exadata Infrastructure, VM Cluster, Grid Infrastructure and Database RU patching, including pre\-checks, validation and rollback planning.
 



 • Administer and troubleshoot Oracle RAC, Grid Infrastructure, ASM, SCAN, VIP, listeners and database services.
 



 • Support Oracle Database 19c and 23ai, including patching, upgrades and migration activities.
 



 • Design and support Data Guard / Active Data Guard, RMAN backup/recovery and DR solutions.
 



 • Monitor and troubleshoot Exadata Storage Servers, cell services, flash/cache, I/O and database performance.
 



 • Perform performance analysis and tuning using AWR, ASH, ADDM, SQL Monitor and Exadata performance metrics.
 



 • Perform regular health checks, capacity reviews, proactive monitoring and performance assessments.
 



 • Lead troubleshooting and RCA for critical P1/P2 production incidents and coordinate with Oracle Support for critical SRs.
 



 • Support database and workload migrations from on\-premises or other Oracle platforms to OCI Exadata.
 



 • Work closely with Oracle DBA, EBS Apps DBA, OCI, middleware, network and security teams.
 



**OCI Infrastructure \& Networking** 




 Strong working knowledge of OCI infrastructure supporting Exadata environments, including:
 



 VCN \& Subnets \| Client \& Backup Networks \| NSGs \| Security Lists \| Route Tables \| DRG \| DNS/SCAN \| FastConnect \| Site\-to\-Site VPN \| OCI IAM \| Vault/KMS \| OCI Monitoring \| Alarms \| Object Storage \| TDE
 



 The candidate should be capable of troubleshooting application\-to\-database, RAC, on\-premises\-to\-OCI and network latency/connectivity issues.
 



**Required Technical Skills** 




 OCI Exadata / ExaDB\-D \| Exadata VM Clusters \| Oracle Database 19c \& 23ai \| Oracle RAC \| Grid Infrastructure \| ASM \| Data Guard \| RMAN \| Exadata Patching \| AWR/ASH \| Performance Tuning \| OCI Networking \| Linux \| Backup \& Recovery \| DR \| Database Migration \| Patching \& Upgrades
 



 Experience supporting large enterprise Oracle database environments is required.
 



 Experience with Oracle E\-Business Suite R12\.2 running on OCI Exadata will be an added advantage.
 



**Preferred Certifications** 




 Relevant Oracle certifications are preferred, particularly:
 



 • Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Architect Professional
 



 • Oracle Cloud Database Services Professional
 



 • Oracle Database Administration OCP / Professional
 



 • Relevant Oracle Database 23ai certification
 



 • Relevant Oracle Exadata, OCI Networking, Security or Migration certifications
 



**Candidate Profile** 




 The candidate should be a hands\-on OCI Exadata Architect / Lead SME, not limited to architecture or OCI networking.
 



 Strong experience in Exadata administration, VM Cluster management, Exadata patching, RAC/ASM, performance troubleshooting and production operations is essential.
 



 The role requires strong communication, customer\-facing, troubleshooting and documentation skills, with the ability to lead technical discussions, production incidents, architecture reviews, migrations, patching and performance optimization in an enterprise managed\-services environment.

title: Senior System Engineer, GIOC
description:
Who We Are
   

  

 Vultr is on a mission to make high\-performance cloud infrastructure easy to use, affordable, and locally accessible for enterprises and AI innovators around the world. With 33 global cloud data center locations, Vultr is trusted by hundreds of thousands of active customers across 185 countries for its flexible, scalable, global Cloud Compute, Cloud GPU, Bare Metal, and Cloud Storage solutions. In December 2024 Vultr announced an equity financing at a $3\.5 billion valuation. Founded by David Aninowsky and self\-funded for over a decade, Vultr has grown to become the world’s largest privately\-held cloud infrastructure company.
   

  

**Vultr Cares**
* Medical Insurance stipend paid annually
* 9 Company\-Paid Holidays
* Generous Leave Policy \+ 1 month paid sabbatical every 5 years \+ Anniversary Bonus each year
* Professional Development Reimbursement
* Internet reimbursement
* Fitness membership reimbursement
* Company paid Wellable subscription


**Join Vultr**
 Vultr is expanding its India presence and is building its first
 **Global Integrated Operations Command Center (GIOC) in Chennai** 
 — the 24x7 nerve center for monitoring, triage, and first response across Vultr’s global
 **cloud, systems, network, and security operations.**
 We are seeking
 **Senior Systems Engineers** 
 to serve as the first line of response for Vultr’s systems estate —
 **compute, storage, operating systems, and virtualization.** 
 This is a frontline operations role for engineers who thrive in a fast\-paced, alert\-driven environment and want to grow into deeper SRE, systems, and platform engineering careers. You must be comfortable working a rotational shift model — including nights, weekends, and holidays — to sustain follow\-the\-sun coverage.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 The
 **Senior Systems Engineer** 
 is the entry point of the GIOC incident lifecycle. You monitor health signals across Vultr’s systems estate, acknowledge and triage alerts within
 **defined first\-response SLAs,** 
 execute documented runbooks to resolve common issues, and escalate cleanly to Senior Engineers when an issue falls outside L2 scope. The role ensures
 **fast, accurate first response** 
 that protects customer experience and keeps incidents moving toward resolution.
   

  

 You operate from a consolidated
 **single\-pane\-of\-glass dashboard,** 
 classifying and routing incidents by severity and tower while owning accurate, complete documentation of every action. Success is measured by
 **first\-response SLA adherence, triage accuracy, and runbook resolution rate.** 
 The role runs on a
 **rotational schedule** 
 to sustain 24x7 coverage.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Alert Monitoring \& First Response**
* Monitor systems\-estate health signals (compute, storage, OS, virtualization) from a consolidated single\-pane\-of\-glass dashboard
* Acknowledge alerts and incidents within first\-response SLA targets
* Perform initial review — read the alert, check recent changes, and review the CMDB before acting


**Triage \& Severity Classification**
* Classify each incident by severity and customer impact, confirming the owning tower (Systems / Network / Security / cross\-tower)
* Route and assign tickets accurately to the correct tower or escalation path
* Sustain triage accuracy at or above the GIOC go\-live standard
* Reassess severity as impact evolves, and declare higher when in doubt


**Runbook\-Driven Resolution**
* Match alert signatures to documented runbooks and execute permitted L2 actions
* Resolve common, well\-understood systems issues end to end within L2 scope
* Document every step taken, with supporting evidence, in the incident ticket


**Escalation \& Handoff**
* Escalate unresolved or out\-of\-scope issues to L2/L3 with a clean, complete handoff (symptom
* evidence collected
* steps tried
* current state)
* Flag missing or ineffective runbooks as runbook gaps for review and continuous improvement
* Initiate and support major\-incident (Sev\-0 / Sev\-1\) bridges per the escalation matrix
* Track escalations to closure and confirm service is restored before resolving the ticket


**Operational Documentation \& Communication**
* Maintain accurate shift logs, ticket updates, and incident timelines
* Provide clear, timely status communication to stakeholders and customers per severity
* Produce thorough shift\-handover notes for seamless continuity


**Continuous Improvement**
* Identify recurring alerts and noise as candidates for tuning and automation
* Contribute to and improve runbooks and knowledge\-base articles
* Participate in post\-incident reviews (PIR) and trend reviews


**Qualifications \& Experience**
* Graduate/Engineer in a relevant field (B.E./B.Tech, or equivalent)
* 5\-8 years of experience in systems administration, NOC/SOC, or IT operations, including hands\-on Linux and/or Windows server administration
* Working knowledge of operating systems — processes, services, and log analysis (Linux and/or Windows)
* Familiarity with compute, storage, and virtualization concepts — VMs, hypervisors, and basic networking
* Understanding of incident\-management fundamentals and severity\-based triage
* Exposure to monitoring/observability tools and ticketing systems (alerting consoles, ITSM)
* Strong written communication for accurate documentation and clean escalation handoffs; willingness and ability to work a rotational 24x7 shift model, including nights, weekends, and holidays
* Proficient in English verbal and written communication


**Preferred Qualifications**
* ITIL V4 Foundation certification or equivalent ITSM knowledge
* Linux certification (RHCSA / LFCS) or a cloud\-fundamentals certification
* Scripting familiarity (Bash, Python, or PowerShell) for routine automation
* Exposure to cloud platforms and GPU / high\-density infrastructure
* Prior experience in a 24x7 NOC, SOC, or command\-center environment, and tools such as JIRA, Confluence, PagerDuty, and observability platforms


**Inclusion \& Privacy**
 We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and experiences, and we prohibit discrimination based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected status under applicable laws. Vultr will consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records in accordance with applicable laws and will not conduct a background check until after an offer of employment has been extended and accepted.
   

  

 We also take your privacy seriously. We handle personal information responsibly and follow applicable laws, including U.S. privacy rules and India’s Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023\. Your data is used only for legitimate business purposes and is protected with proper security measures.
   

  

 Where allowed by law, applicants may request details about the data we collect, access or delete their information, withdraw consent for its use, and opt out of nonessential communications. For more details, please see our Privacy Policy.

description:

title: Transformation Lead - AD
description:
**Role:** 
 Transformation Lead
   

  

**Business Vertical:** 
 IOA – Tech
   

  

**Role Summary**
 Hands\-on leader who acts as one of our most senior technical experts in the field. This is a unique, dual\-mission role. Externally, you will engage with our most strategic clients in a "forward\-deployed" capacity, leading technical workshops to design and integrate our data solutions into their complex ecosystems. Internally, you will use these client insights to architect and build the next generation of AI\-powered tools and workflows, radically optimizing our own data annotation processes. Your ultimate goal is to create an unbeatable competitive advantage by continuously improving our efficiency, quality, and delivery, directly reducing our clients' Total Cost of Ownership (TCO).
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Client Solution Engineering \& Integration (External Focus)**
* Lead Technical Discovery \& Solution Design: Post\-sale, partner with the Solutioning team to lead deep\-dive technical workshops with clients. Deconstruct their current workflows, data challenges, and business objectives.
* Architect Custom Integration Plans: Design and map out how our platform and services will integrate seamlessly into the client's existing AI/ML pipelines and infrastructure.
* Act as the "Art of the Possible" Guide: Serve as the primary technical advisor to clients, demonstrating how our advanced capabilities, custom tools, and innovative workflows can solve their most difficult data challenges and accelerate their AI initiatives.
* Bridge to the Platform Team: Translate complex client requirements into precise technical specifications and user stories for our core Platform Deployment \& Management team, ensuring our platform roadmap is directly informed by real\-world client needs.
* Oversee Proofs of Concept (POCs): Lead and develop targeted POCs to prove the value and viability of our solutions within the client's environment, de\-risking large\-scale engagements.


**Internal Process Transformation \& Innovation (Internal Focus)**
* Drive Process Excellence: Be the owner of operational efficiency for our data annotation workforce. Continuously analyze our Human\-in\-the\-Loop (HITL) workflows to identify and eliminate bottlenecks.
* Develop AI\-Powered "Co\-Pilots" and Accelerators: Architect, build, and deploy a portfolio of internal tools and intelligent agents that augment our human annotators. This includes automated quality checks, predictive assistance, and workflow\-agnostic automation scripts.
* Engineer "Safety Nets": Design and implement automated quality assurance (QA) systems and predictive monitoring to ensure we consistently exceed client SLAs for accuracy and throughput.
* Champion Human\-in\-the\-Loop Optimization: Leverage Generative AI, LLMs (fine\-tuning, RAG), and computer vision models to create systems that make our human workforce smarter, faster, and more accurate.
* Quantify Business Impact: Develop and maintain a framework to measure the ROI of your transformation initiatives, clearly demonstrating their impact on project margins, delivery speed, and client TCO.


**Skills \& Qualifications**
**Required Qualifications:**
* Experience: 14\+ years in a technology field, with at least 5 years in a senior, client\-facing technical role such as a Solutions Architect, Forward Deployed Engineer, Professional Services Consultant, or Transformation Lead.
* Applied AI \& Process Automation: Proven, hands\-on experience building and deploying production\-grade AI/ML systems specifically for process automation and optimization. This is more important than pure research experience.
* Generative AI Stack Expertise: Deep, practical experience with the modern Generative AI stack, including LLMs (fine\-tuning, RAG), agentic frameworks, and vector databases. You must have built things with these technologies.
* Hybrid Skillset: A demonstrated ability to operate at the intersection of deep technology and business strategy. You must be able to write code and architect systems, but also create a compelling business case and present to a client executive.
* Cloud Architecture: Deep architectural expertise in one or more major cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), including their managed AI/ML services (e.g., SageMaker, Vertex AI).


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Consultative Mindset: A natural ability to listen, diagnose problems, and guide clients and internal teams toward elegant, effective solutions.
* Data Annotation Domain Knowledge: Direct experience with data annotation platforms, data quality challenges, and the operational dynamics of large\-scale data labeling workforces.
* Experience Building Internal Tools: A track record of identifying an internal business need and building a software solution to address it, driving measurable efficiency gains.
* An advanced degree (master's or PhD) in Computer Science, AI, or a related field is a strong plus.
* A portfolio of projects (e.g., GitHub) or detailed case studies demonstrating your work in building AI\-driven solutions.

title: Zscalar/Zero Trust Security Architect - Consultant
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Zscalar/Zero Trust
   

  

 Consultant**
 We are seeking an experienced Zscaler Architect / Senior Engineer to lead and support the implementation, configuration, and migration of Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA) and Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) solutions in enterprise environments. This role will help design and deliver Zero Trust access models, modernize remote access, and support migration from legacy VPN and proxy technologies. The ideal candidate brings strong hands\-on Zscaler delivery experience, solid network security fundamentals, and the ability to work across security, network, IAM, and endpoint teams.
   

  

**Work you'll do**
 As a Consultant on the Cyber team, you will be responsible for:
   

  

* Leading and supporting the implementation, configuration, and migration of Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA) and Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) solutions.
* Assessing current\-state network and security architecture and designing Zero Trust access models aligned to business and security requirements.
* Planning and executing migration from legacy VPN, proxy, and remote access technologies to Zscaler platforms.
* Configuring ZIA and ZPA policies, application segmentation, connector deployment, authentication, forwarding methods, and user\-to\-application connectivity.
* Troubleshooting connectivity, performance, and policy issues and supporting pilot, rollout, cutover, and post\-migration activities.


**The team**
 Deloitte’s Cyber team helps organizations build, operate, and enhance security capabilities across identity, network, cloud, and application environments. The team works with clients to modernize security architecture, enable secure access, and support enterprise transformation through scalable, business\-aligned solutions. Professionals in this practice collaborate across cybersecurity, infrastructure, and technology stakeholders to address complex security and connectivity challenges.
   

  

**Location: Hyderabad/Bengaluru/Pune/Chennai**
**Shift Timings: Regular India Shift Timing**
**Qualifications**
 Required:
   

  

* 6\-9 years of experience in network security, cloud security, or enterprise security architecture.
* Experience implementing and migrating Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA) and Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) in enterprise environments.
* Experience configuring ZIA security policies, including URL filtering, Secure Sockets Layer (SSL) inspection, authentication, forwarding methods, and access controls.
* Experience configuring ZPA application segmentation, connector deployment, access policies, and user\-to\-application connectivity.
* Experience integrating Zscaler with identity and security platforms, including Microsoft Entra ID, Okta, Security Assertion Markup Language (SAML), System for Cross\-domain Identity Management (SCIM), security information and event management (SIEM), endpoint detection and response (EDR), or cloud access security broker (CASB) tools.
* Experience with Domain Name System (DNS), Transmission Control Protocol/Internet Protocol (TCP/IP), routing, firewall policies, proxy technologies, and VPN migration.
* Experience creating technical documentation, including architecture diagrams, runbooks, migration plans, and operational handover materials.


 Preferred:
   

  

* Experience designing Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) solutions and remote access modernization programs.
* Experience with Zscaler Digital Experience (ZDX) for experience monitoring and user troubleshooting.
* Experience deploying Zscaler Client Connector and integrating with endpoint platforms.
* Experience with Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services (AWS), or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
* Experience supporting large\-scale enterprise transformation or network security modernization programs.
* Zscaler Certified Cloud Administrator (ZCCA), Zscaler Certified Cloud Professional (ZCCP) for ZIA or ZPA, or Zscaler Certified Cloud Specialist (ZCCS).


 This position is aligned with the Core Talent Model. To view the associated benefit package, please reference this document https://resources.deloitte.com/sites/dnet\-tod\-usi/Shared Documents/Benefits/USIBenefitsBrochureforPlanG.pdf
   

  

**Our purpose**
 Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
   

  

**Our people and culture**
 Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
   

  

**Professional development**
 At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state\-of\-the\-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
**About Kinaxis**
 Are you looking to join an innovative, market\-leading company where you can truly elevate your career? At Kinaxis we are serious about culture, we are serious about technology, we are serious about customers, and we are serious about not taking ourselves too seriously. If you are looking to be part of an incredible growth story, then we might just be the place for you!
   

  

 In 1984, we started out as a team of three engineers. Today, we have grown to become a global organization with over 2000 employees around the world, 6 global office and a best\-in\-class HQ in Ottawa, Canada. As winners of several Top Employer awards globally, we are proud to work with our customers and employees towards solving some of the biggest challenges facing supply chains today.
   

  

 Kinaxis is a global leader in modern supply chain orchestration, powering complex global supply chains, and supporting the people who manage them. Our powerful, AI infused platform provides full transparency and visibility across end\-to\-end supply chains, enabling our customers to make faster, better decisions. We are trusted by renowned global brands to provide the agility and predictability needed to navigate today’s volatility and disruption. With more than 40,000 users in over 100 countries, we are expanding our team as we continue to innovate and revolutionize how we support our customers.
   

  

**Location**
 Chennai / Bangalore \- India
   

  

 Work Model \- Hybrid
   

  

**About The Role**
 Kinaxis is building a Forward Deployed Engineers team whose singular mission is to Help customer transform how work gets done in the Agentic Age. This is not a consulting role, and it is not a features team. It is a Multi deployment unit embedded, operating with the speed and ownership culture of a startup.
   

  

 This team operates as a POD inside Kinaxis — a small, tight unit with end\-to\-end ownership and a startup mentality inside a larger company. We are scrappy, resourceful, and self\-directed. We move fast, trade tasks to whoever is closest to the need, and stay relentlessly focused on customer impact.
   

  

 You will work shoulder\-to\-shoulder with customers — from warehouse floor to executive sponsor — designing, building, and shipping Agentic AI solutions on the Kinaxis Maestro Platform. When a solution works, you abstract it into a reusable pattern. When something breaks in production, you own the fix. You operate in a POD team: tight, multi\-disciplinary, and self\-directed.
   

  

 💡 Attitude is the biggest asset. We hire for trajectory and mindset, not years on a resume. The right bias to action, ownership, and appetite to keep learning cannot be taught — but every technical skill here can be. Bring those, and we will invest in the rest.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
**Build the data backbone for AI Agents on Maestro**
* Design, build, and operate production data pipelines — ingestion, transformation, serving, and monitoring — that feed agentic AI workflows on the Kinaxis Maestro Platform.
* Integrate customer data sources (ERP systems, data warehouses, supply chain applications, flat files, APIs) into a unified data layer that agents can reason over reliably.
* Build and maintain data platform services, tooling, and infrastructure that enable reliable data ingestion, processing, sharing, and discovery across customer deployments.
* Own data quality end\-to\-end: profiling, validation, anomaly detection, and lineage — because an agent is only as good as the data behind it.


**Ship AI Agents alongside the POD**
* Partner with AI\-focused FDEs to design, develop, and ship agentic AI workflows — including multi\-agent orchestration, RAG pipelines, and tool\-use patterns — ensuring the data layer is production\-ready.
* Translate messy, real\-world customer data landscapes into clean, well\-modeled foundations that agents can consume — iterating rapidly from prototype to deployment.
* Troubleshoot complex production issues across the full stack data pipelines, model context, API layers, and infrastructure — in live customer environments.


**Own the full solution lifecycle**
* Carry multiple customer engagements in parallel; set expectations early, renegotiate honestly when priorities shift, and own outcomes end\-to\-end.
* Define and track success in business terms: data freshness SLAs, pipeline reliability, query performance, exception rates — not just deployment completion.
* Drive platform engineering best practices through Infrastructure\-as\-Code, CI/CD automation, observability, and automated testing across customer deployments.


**Work inside a POD team**
* Operate as part of a small, self\-directed POD within Kinaxis tasks traded fluidly to whoever has the right skills, focus maintained with urgency.
* Partner closely with Product and Engineering to convert field learnings and repeatable data patterns into durable platform capabilities, not one\-off scripts.
* Serve as the technical face of the team in customer rooms — from IC\-level engineers to skeptical architects to VP sponsors and build genuine trust across all of them.


**Drive adoption and change**
* Guide customer data teams through solution transitions: the new data architecture has to stick, not just ship.
* Mentor customer teams on modern data engineering practices, agentic data workflows, and new operating patterns so capability transfers and does not remain dependent on you.


****What we are looking for****
**Bias to action**
 You move on what matters. You finish what you start. The outcome is yours — no waiting for perfect clarity.
   

  

**Self\-directed**
 You identify what matters, secure the help or learning you need, and deliver — without being told.
   

  

**Always learning**
 Every customer, teammate, and new tool is a chance to level up. Not knowing something is fine; refusing to learn it is not.
   

  

**Customer\-obsessed**
 You can sit with a frustrated VP, a skeptical architect, or a junior analyst — and leave each one feeling heard, helped, and impressed.
   

  

**Comfortable with ambiguity**
 Undefined problem, undefined scope, undefined success metric — and you still ship.
   

  

**Drives change, not just code**
 You guide customers through transitions and mentor their teams to adopt new ways of working.
   

  

 The following are the technical areas we look for. You do not need depth in all of them — we look for strong foundations, a growth trajectory, and the ability to pick up what is missing quickly.
   

  

**Data Engineering \& Platforms (Primary)**
* Strong hands\-on experience building and operating production data pipelines — ingestion, transformation, serving, and monitoring — using tools such as Spark, Airflow, Kafka, dbt, or equivalents.
* Deep working knowledge of modern data platforms (Databricks, Snowflake, BigQuery, or similar), including Unity Catalog, Delta Lake, data modeling, query optimization, and performance tuning at scale.
* Strong SQL skills and deep understanding of data modeling, schema design, and large\-scale data processing patterns.
* Experience with data governance practices: RBAC, PII handling, data lineage, data quality frameworks, and enterprise\-scale data management.
* Hands\-on experience with cloud platforms (Azure, GCP, or AWS) and Infrastructure\-as\-Code tools (Terraform, Pulumi, or similar).
* Strong debugging instincts with imperfect, real\-world data in production environments — you have untangled broken pipelines at 2 AM and lived to tell the tale.


**AI \& Agentic Development**
* Hands\-on experience building LLM\-based applications — RAG systems, multi\-agent workflows, tool\-use patterns, prompt and context engineering.
* Familiarity with modern AI\-assisted development tools (Copilot, Claude Code, agentic IDE workflows) as daily practice, not novelty.
* Understanding of agentic orchestration patterns — when to use single vs. multi\-agent architectures, how to handle memory and state.


**Software Engineering**
* Solid, hands\-on software engineering fundamentals: you have built and shipped real systems, not just scripts.
* Proficiency in at least one backend language (Python strongly preferred) and the ability to read and contribute across a polyglot codebase.
* Experience with REST and streaming APIs, authentication patterns, and integration with enterprise systems.


**Data Engineering \& Platforms**
* Ability to build and maintain data pipelines — ingestion, transformation, serving, and monitoring — using tools such as Airflow, Kafka, dbt, or equivalents.
* Working familiarity with modern data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, or similar), including data modeling and performance fundamentals.
* Strong debugging instincts with imperfect, real\-world data in production environments.


**Supply Chain Domain (Nice to Have)**
* Prior exposure to supply chain planning, logistics, or operations domains is a genuine plus — not a requirement.
* Experience with or curiosity about platforms like Kinaxis, SAP IBP, o9, or Blue Yonder is welcome context.


**Experience \& Background**
* 3 – 6 years of professional experience in data engineering, data platform engineering, software engineering, or a technical\-founder role. Strong candidates at either end of that range are welcome to apply.
* Prior exposure to customer\-facing technical roles — solutions engineering, forward deployment, technical consulting, or a startup where you wore multiple hats — is a strong signal, though not a requirement.


**How You Will Succeed In This Role**
* You measure your own success in business outcomes — efficiency gains, exception reduction, SLA improvements — not lines of code shipped.
* You bring field learnings back into the platform, helping abstract what works into durable, scalable capabilities.
* You operate with high agency: you unblock yourself, adapt when conditions change, and take ownership end\-to\-end without requiring close supervision.
* You are curious and pragmatic — you explore new tools and apply them where they create real value, not because they are new.
* You communicate clearly across engineering, product, and business stakeholders — written, verbal, and in the room.


**\#Fulltime, \#Full\-time** 
**\#Associate**
**Work With Impact:** 
 Our platform directly helps companies power the world’s supply chains. We see the results of what we do out in the world every day, when we see store shelves stocked, when medications are available for our loved ones, and so much more.
   

  

**Work with Fortune 500 Brands:** 
 Companies across industries trust us to help them take control of their integrated business planning and digital supply chain. Some of our customers include Lockheed Martin, Unilever, P\&G, ExxonMobil, Cisco and more.
   

  

**Social Responsibility at Kinaxis:** 
 Our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion Committee weighs in on hiring practices, talent assessment training materials, and mandatory training on unconscious bias and inclusion fundamentals. Sustainability is key to what we do and we’re committed to a long\-term net\-zero operations strategy. We are involved in our communities and support causes where we can make the most impact.
   

  

 People matter at Kinaxis and here are some of the perks and benefits we offer, which may vary by location and employee:
   

  

* Flexible vacation and Kinaxis Days (company\-wide days off)
* Flexible work options
* Physical and mental well\-being programs
* Regularly scheduled virtual fitness classes
* Mentorship programs, training, and career development
* Recognition programs and referral rewards
* Hackathons


 For more information, visit the Kinaxis website at www.kinaxis.com or the company’s blog at http://blog.kinaxis.com .
   

  

 Kinaxis welcomes candidates to apply to our inclusive community. We provide accommodations upon request to ensure fairness and accessibility throughout our recruitment process for all candidates, including those with specific needs or disabilities. If you require an accommodation, please reach out to us at recruitmentprograms@kinaxis.com. This contact information is for accessibility requests only and cannot be used to inquire about the status of applications.
   

  

 Kinaxis is committed to ensuring a fair and transparent recruitment process. We use artificial intelligence (AI) tools in the initial step of the recruitment process to compare submitted resumes against the job description to identify candidates whose education, experience, and skills most closely match the requirements of the role. After the initial screening, all subsequent decisions regarding your application, including final selection, are made by our human recruitment team. AI does not make any final hiring decisions.

**About The Role**
 As a POSITION\_NAME, become a part of a cross\-functional development team engineering experiences of tomorrow. Lead the transformation of software development lifecycle into an AI\-agentic model — where autonomous and semi\-autonomous AI agents handle defined portions of requirements analysis, coding, testing, code review, and deployment, under a governed human\-oversight framework. Own both the technical architecture and the organizational rollout.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Assess the current SDLC end\-to\-end and identify which stages are suitable for agent autonomy, agent\-assist, or remain human\-owned (a maturity/readiness map, not a blanket "automate everything")
* Design and stand up the agentic architecture: agent orchestration layer, tool/permission scoping, approval and escalation gates, integration with existing CI/CD and code review systems
* Define and implement guardrails: security review for agent\-generated code, cost/usage controls, rollback and audit mechanisms, human sign\-off checkpoints for high\-risk changes
* Select and integrate the agent tooling stack (build vs. buy decisions across orchestration frameworks, coding agents, testing agents, deployment agents)
* Run a phased rollout (pilot team → expanded pilot → org\-wide) with clear success metrics at each stage — cycle time, defect rate, agent\-error rate, developer trust/adoption
* Own change management: training engineering teams on new workflows, redefining code\-review and QA roles, working with security/compliance on new risk surfaces
* Report to engineering leadership on ROI, risk, and adoption — with honest calibration of what's actually autonomous vs. assisted


**Requirements**
* 10\+ years software engineering experience, including senior/staff\-level architecture ownership
* Demonstrated production experience with AI agent frameworks and LLM tool\-use patterns
* Deep knowledge of modern SDLC/DevOps tooling and CI/CD pipelines
* Experience leading a cross\-functional technology change initiative (not just a technical build)


**Desirable**
* Experience in a regulated or security\-sensitive environment (agent guardrails matter more there)
* Prior consulting/transformation\-program background
* Familiarity with MCP (Model Context Protocol) or similar agent\-tool integration standards


**What’s in it for you?**
* Strong community: Work alongside top professionals in a friendly, open\-door environment
* Growth focus: Take on large\-scale projects with a global impact and expand your expertise
* Tailored learning: Boost your skills with internal events (meetups, conferences, workshops), Udemy access, language courses, and company\-paid certifications
* Endless opportunities: Explore diverse domains through internal mobility, finding the best fit to gain hands\-on experience with cutting\-edge technologies
* Care: We’ve got you covered with company\-paid medical insurance, mental health support, and financial \& legal consultations


**About Us**
 At Ciklum, we are always exploring innovations, empowering each other to achieve more, and engineering solutions that matter. With us, you’ll work with cutting\-edge technologies, contribute to impactful projects, and be part of a One Team culture that values collaboration and progress.
   

  

 India is a strategic innovation hub for Ciklum, with growing teams in Chennai and Pune leading advancements in EdgeTech, AR/VR, IoT, and beyond. Join us to collaborate on game\-changing solutions and take your career to the next level.

IST/Switch is an end\-to\-end software solution for businesses that manage real\-world Electronic Payments, Mobile Commerce, and Internet payment processing across the entire payment lifecycle – merchants, issuers, acquirers, processors, payment gateways and card associations.
   

  

 The Technical Support Specialist (L2\) for the Banking System is responsible for providing advanced technical support, troubleshooting, and issue resolution for banking applications. This role serves as the second line of defense, escalating complex issues to L3 support when necessary while ensuring timely resolutions to maintain system stability and performance. The ideal candidate will have strong problem\-solving skills, experience in banking systems, and a client\-focused approach.
   

  

**What You Will Be Doing**
* Diagnose, analyze, and resolve technical issues related to the banking system

* Liaise with business users and stakeholders to provide technical insights and status updates
* Maintain detailed records of incidents, troubleshooting steps, and resolutions

* Track repeat incidents and take necessary action with L3 Support
* Update knowledge base articles, FAQs, and internal documentation
* Provide training and guidance to L1 support teams and handle \& manage the roster of the whole team
* Ensure compliance with banking regulations, security policies, and data protection standards
* Support audit processes and provide necessary documentation when required
* Monitor system access controls and assist in security\-related configurations
* Monitor L1 team activities for day\-to\-day operations and coordinate with Bank and Vendors of Bank for daily operation
* Knowledge of regulatory requirements in banking IT


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or any Circuit Branches
* Overall 4\+ years of experience
* 3\+ years of experience in application support or IT operations within the Banking Payment Domain
* Experience with SQL, Oracle, or other relational databases for query execution and scripting
* Familiarity with Linux/Unix and Windows server environments
* Experience with APIs, web services, and system integrations
* Understanding of ITIL processes (Incident, Problem, Change Management, Automation)
* Perform SIT/UAT testing for all Change Requests and Incident fixes
* Should have worked in ISO8583 Switch related environment; IST Switch experience is advantageous
* Strong communication skills to interact with technical teams and clients


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Hands\-on experience with banking applications such as IST Switch ISO8583, VTS, MC \& Boss Simulator, or similar systems
* Excellent problem\-solving and analytical skills in banking systems and payment domain

 Opportunities to innovate in fintech
   

  

 Inclusive and diverse team atmosphere
   

  

 Professional and personal development

 Competitive salary and benefits

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.

 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.

The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.

Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is seeking a Senior AI Engineer to support the design and delivery of AI\-led solutions across Identity and Access Management and Cybersecurity domains. This role will help shape how AI capabilities are applied to modern IAM challenges such as identity governance, access management, privileged access, directory services and non\-human identity security.
   

  

 As a senior profile, the candidate will work closely with IAM, Cyber, cloud and business stakeholders to understand client problems, identify practical AI opportunities and convert them into working solutions, prototypes and scalable delivery assets. The focus is not only on technology implementation, but also on improving identity risk visibility, access decisioning, governance efficiency and operational effectiveness.
   

  

 The ideal candidate should bring strong hands\-on engineering experience, curiosity to work in the IAM and Cyber domain, and the ability to apply AI, automation and analytics to solve real enterprise identity challenges. While the role requires practical exposure to AI and IAM technologies, the emphasis is on problem solving, consulting mindset, solution ownership and the ability to contribute to enterprise\-scale IAM transformation programs.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Design, develop and operationalize AI solutions for IAM and Cybersecurity use cases across SSO, MFA, Conditional Access, IGA, PAM, AD/Entra ID and NHI domains.
* Build hands\-on AI/ML capabilities using Python, PowerShell, LLM/SLM APIs, embeddings, RAG, LangChain, LangGraph, MCP, ADKs and AI orchestration engines.
* Develop agentic AI workflows, copilots and automation frameworks for access requests, certification campaigns, provisioning, privileged access, remediation and identity operations.
* Integrate AI solutions with SailPoint, Saviynt, CyberArk, Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, Azure, AWS, Microsoft Graph API, SIEM/SOAR, Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Defender, CrowdStrike and XDR platforms.
* Analyze identity, access, privilege, vault, directory, activity and security logs to identify risk patterns, anomalies, access recommendations, role mining opportunities and policy gaps.
* Support AI\-driven IAM governance including risk\-based authentication, risk\-based provisioning, access reviews, compliance checks, SOD, identity lifecycle orchestration and audit\-ready reporting.
* Apply ML, classification, optimization, time series analysis, pattern recognition, NLP, UEBA, anomaly detection and predictive risk scoring for identity and access intelligence.
* Work on Non\-Human Identity use cases including service accounts, managed identities, service principals, enterprise applications, API\-based identities, workload identities, agent identities, token misuse and agent overreach controls.
* Contribute to PAM analytics and automation across CyberArk, Privilege Cloud, EPM, EPV, CPM, PSM, JIT/JEA, password rotation, secret lifecycle management, session monitoring and vault log analytics.
* Create dashboards and insights using Power BI, Tableau and identity analytics views to explain access risk, compliance posture, user activity trends and remediation priorities.
* Collaborate with business, cyber and IAM stakeholders to convert problem statements into working prototypes, scalable solutions and executive\-ready recommendations.


**QUALIFICATIONS:**
**Required Skills**
* 5\+ years of hands\-on experience in AI engineering, software development, data science, automation, cybersecurity analytics or IAM technology delivery.
* Practical experience building AI applications using LLM/SLM APIs, RAG, embeddings, prompt engineering, agentic AI, AI agents, copilots and multi\-agent workflows.
* Strong programming and automation experience in Python, PowerShell, APIs, SQL basics and Microsoft Graph API; exposure to HTML, CSS and JavaScript is preferred.
* Hands\-on exposure to Azure AI, OpenAI, AWS, Python\-based AI/ML frameworks, ML models, classification, optimization, NLP, pattern recognition, time series analysis and anomaly detection.
* Working knowledge of IAM concepts including SSO, MFA, Conditional Access, SAML, OAuth, OIDC with PKCE, authentication, authorization, federation, certificate management and key management.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, Entra Connect, Cloud Sync, Directory Services, DNS, Global Catalog, GPO, OU, Domains/Forests, FSMO roles and Sites and Services.
* Experience or strong exposure to IGA platforms and concepts such as SailPoint, Saviynt, identity lifecycle, access reviews, certification campaigns, role mining, SOD, access risk and policy compliance.
* Experience or strong exposure to PAM concepts and tools including CyberArk, Privilege Cloud, EPM, EPV, CPM, PSM, JIT/JEA, password rotation, secrets, session monitoring and vault logs.
* Understanding of NHI and AI identity security including service accounts, managed identities, service principals, enterprise applications, API\-based identities, workload identities, agent identities and token controls.
* Experience with security monitoring or analytics platforms such as SIEM, SOAR, UEBA, Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Defender, CrowdStrike, XDR and Identity Protection.
* Strong consulting mindset with the ability to communicate AI, IAM and Cybersecurity topics clearly to technical teams and leadership stakeholders.


**Nice to have**
* Experience identifying AI use cases for IAM transformation, identity analytics, access recommendations, privileged access recommendations, NHI governance and automated remediation.
* Experience with data pipelines, identity and privilege analytics pipelines, model monitoring, observability, MLOps and scalable deployment of enterprise AI solutions.
* Experience with Power BI, Tableau, dashboards and data storytelling for access risk, compliance posture and identity operations.
* Exposure to SOX, GDPR, HIPAA, ISO 27001, CISSP, CISM, SailPoint, Saviynt, CyberArk, Azure AI or Google ML certifications is preferred.
* Prior experience in a consulting, professional services or large enterprise environment is a plus.


**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.

Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.

 From entry\-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.

Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.

 Successful candidates advance to a competency\-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
   

  

 “We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion”.

title: Senior Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
description:
**Job title:** 
 Senior Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
   

  

**Location:** 
 Chennai
   

  

**Reports to:** 
 Manager, IT Systems Administration
   

  

**Contract:** 
 Permanent, Full\-time
   

  

**Schedule:** 
 Shift aligning to approximately 4–5 hours of overlap with US Central Time daily; off\-hours availability required for monthly maintenance windows and semi\-annual DR tests
   

  

**Purpose of the Role**
 Newell Brands is seeking a highly skilled Senior Cloud Infrastructure Engineer to join our Cloud Infrastructure team. This is a senior\-level, hands\-on role responsible for designing, securing, and operating cloud infrastructure across a multi\-cloud environment that spans Microsoft Azure, AWS, and Google Cloud, as well as on\-premises VMware ESXi infrastructure.
   

  

 While Microsoft Azure is the primary platform today, this role requires a strong multi\-cloud mindset and the ability to operate effectively across cloud providers as the organization's footprint evolves. The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in cloud security, networking, and complex troubleshooting, and can work independently with minimal direction in a globally distributed team. This role requires a work schedule providing approximately 4–5 hours of daily overlap with US Central Time, as well as availability outside normal hours for scheduled monthly maintenance windows and semi\-annual disaster recovery (DR) tests. Experience with VMware technologies, including VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF), is a valued plus.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
**Cloud Infrastructure \& Operations**
* Design, deploy, and manage scalable infrastructure across Azure, AWS, and Google Cloud, including compute, storage, and container platforms such as AKS and EKS
* Maintain and optimize cloud account structures including Azure subscriptions, AWS accounts, and landing zones across providers
* Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform, Bicep, or ARM templates with a preference for cloud\-agnostic tooling where practical
* Implement automation using PowerShell, Azure CLI, AWS CLI, and native cloud automation services to reduce manual effort and improve consistency
* Monitor infrastructure health across cloud platforms using Azure Monitor, AWS CloudWatch, Log Analytics, and other native tools, responding proactively to alerts and capacity trends


**Cloud Security**
* Architect and enforce security controls across cloud environments in alignment with Zero Trust principles and a consistent multi\-cloud security posture
* Manage Azure Role\-Based Access Control (RBAC) and AWS IAM policies across cloud environments
* Conduct security assessments and remediate findings from vulnerability scans, cloud security posture tools, and policy compliance checks
* Manage secrets governance including Azure Key Vault and AWS Secrets Manager, encryption at rest and in transit, and key lifecycle management
* Maintain compliance posture across regulatory and corporate policy requirements in all cloud environments


**Cloud Networking**
* Design and manage virtual network topologies across Azure (VNets, hub\-spoke) and AWS (VPCs, Transit Gateway) with consistent routing and segmentation standards
* Configure and maintain cloud\-native firewalls, Network Security Groups (NSGs), security groups, and DDoS protection across providers
* Implement and operate load balancing and traffic management services including Azure Load Balancer, Application Gateway, Azure Front Door, and AWS equivalents
* Manage Azure DNS, Private DNS Zones, AWS Route 53, and name resolution across hybrid and multi\-cloud environments
* Troubleshoot complex network issues across hybrid and multi\-cloud environments including routing, connectivity, and DNS resolution failures


**Troubleshooting \& Incident Response**
* Serve as a senior escalation point for cloud infrastructure incidents across all platforms, driving rapid diagnosis and resolution
* Lead post\-incident reviews, document root cause analyses, and implement preventive measures
* Use platform\-native diagnostics and log analytics tools to investigate performance degradation and outages
* Participate in on\-call rotation for critical infrastructure support as needed


**Maintenance, DR, \& Business Continuity**
* Actively participate in monthly infrastructure maintenance windows, which are scheduled outside of normal business hours
* Support semi\-annual disaster recovery (DR) tests, including failover validation, documentation, and post\-test reporting
* Contribute to DR planning and runbook development to ensure recovery procedures remain current and tested across cloud environments


**On\-Premises \& Collaboration**
* Support VMware ESXi and on\-premises virtualization environments as needed
* Contribute to cloud adoption and migration projects, providing multi\-cloud expertise during design and execution phases
* Share technical knowledge across the team; contribute to infrastructure standards, runbooks, and architectural decision records


**Minimum**
**What You’ll Need:**
* 6\+ years of hands\-on experience in cloud infrastructure, with strong depth in at least two major cloud platforms (Azure required; AWS strongly preferred)
* Demonstrated expertise in cloud security fundamentals including RBAC/IAM, Zero Trust principles, secrets governance, and encryption; working knowledge of Entra ID, Conditional Access, and PIM
* Strong cloud networking skills spanning virtual networks, firewalls, load balancers, DNS, and Private DNS Zones across Azure and AWS
* Proven ability to troubleshoot complex issues across compute, storage, networking, and identity layers in a multi\-cloud environment
* Proficiency in Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, Bicep, or ARM templates
* Proficiency in cloud automation using PowerShell, Azure CLI, and/or AWS CLI
* Familiarity with cloud monitoring and observability tools across providers (Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, AWS CloudWatch)
* Comfortable working outside normal hours to support scheduled monthly maintenance windows and semi\-annual DR tests
* Ability to work a shift providing approximately 4–5 hours of daily overlap with US Central Time
* Strong documentation skills and ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to non\-technical stakeholders
* Business\-level English proficiency (verbal and written) required
* Ability to work independently and effectively in a fully remote environment across global time zones.


**Your Advantage**
* Cloud certifications — one or more of the following are preferred:
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ\-305\)
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Security Engineer Associate (AZ\-500\)
* AZ\-700: Designing and Implementing Microsoft Azure Networking Solutions
* AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate or Professional
* AWS Certified SysOps Administrator – Associate or Professional
* AWS Certified Security – Specialty
* Experience with VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF9\) or prior VMware vSphere/ESXi administration
* Exposure to Google Cloud Platform (GCP) in a production environment
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps tooling such as Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions
* Familiarity with IT service management practices (ITIL) and change management processes

And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Designation AIOps Manager**
**Job Description**
* Architect and implement enterprise\-grade AIOps solutions to automate incident detection, root cause analysis, and remediation across cloud and hybrid environments.
* Lead the integration of telemetry data from tools like Prometheus, Grafana, AppDynamics, Dynatrace, and Azure Monitor into centralized AIOps platforms for unified observability and intelligent event correlation.
* Design and maintain ML models in Python for anomaly detection, predictive analytics, and operational forecasting, ensuring scalability and accuracy.
* Build and optimize real\-time and batch data pipelines using Apache Kafka, Logstash, and Fluentd to process logs, metrics, and traces from distributed systems.
* Collaborate with DevOps, SRE, and platform engineering teams to embed AIOps capabilities into CI/CD workflows and infrastructure\-as\-code practices.
* Drive automation of operational tasks and remediation workflows using Python, Azure Functions, and orchestration tools to enable self\-healing systems.
* Develop dashboards and visualizations using Grafana, Kibana, or Power BI to deliver actionable insights to engineering, operations, and business teams.
* Implement alert noise reduction strategies using ML\-based filtering, deduplication, and suppression techniques to improve signal\-to\-noise ratio.
* Ensure compliance with security, governance, and audit policies, embedding DevSecOps principles and aligning with regulatory standards.
* Lead technical evaluations of AIOps platforms and tools, making recommendations for adoption based on business needs and operational maturity.
* Manage and mentor a team of AIOps engineers, fostering a culture of innovation, continuous learning, and operational excellence.
* Partner with business stakeholders to identify opportunities for cost optimization, risk reduction, and service reliability improvements through AIOps.
* Contribute to strategic roadmaps, budget planning, and vendor assessments, aligning AIOps initiatives with broader IT and business goals.
* Stay current with emerging trends in AIOps, observability, cloud\-native operations, and AI\-driven automation, and drive their adoption within the organization.


**Desired Profile**
* 9\+ years of experience in IT operations, DevOps, or SRE, with at least 3 years in AIOps or AI/ML\-driven automation.
* Proven experience in technical leadership, team management, and cross\-functional collaboration.
* Deep expertise in AIOps platforms: Moogsoft, BigPanda, Splunk ITSI, ServiceNow ITOM, or custom ML\-based solutions.
* Strong proficiency in Python, with working knowledge of SQL, PowerShell, and Bash.
* Hands\-on experience with Azure, AWS, or GCP, including monitoring and automation services.
* Skilled in CI/CD tools (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins), IaC (Terraform, Ansible), and Kubernetes.
* Familiarity with observability stacks (ELK, OpenTelemetry, Kafka) and data engineering workflows.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and problem\-solving skills.


**Experience:** 
 9 years and above
   

  

**Education:** 
 B.Tech. / BS in Computer Science
   

  

**Technical Skills \& Certifications**
* Certified in cloud platforms: Azure Data Engineer Associate, AWS Data Analytics, or Google Data Engineer.
* Proficient in Python, SQL, and Bash for automation and data workflows.
* Experience with Apache Kafka, Spark, AWS Glue, and ETL tools like NiFi, Talend, or ADF.
* Skilled in managing data on Azure Data Lake, Amazon Redshift, or BigQuery.
* Familiar with CI/CD, Terraform, Docker, Kubernetes, and monitoring tools like Prometheus and Grafana.
* Strong understanding of DevSecOps, data governance, and compliance frameworks. Understanding of monitoring tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK) and DevSecOps principles.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Environment Analyst, Associate Vice President
description:
Join us as an Environment Analyst
   

  

* In this key role, you’ll support a set of environments used by a platform’s applications and assist as a point of contact for environment related activities
* We’ll look to you to assist environment managers in preparing a rolling environmental strategy which considers risks in relation to stability and resilience
* You’ll be joining a collaborative and supportive team, and have the opportunity to work with a range of stakeholders across the bank
* We're offering this role at associate vice president level


 What you'll do
   

  

 We’re looking for an Environment Analyst to enable the successful implementation of platform change and deliver customer value by assisting environment managers to deliver complex and critical environment related activities. You’ll help create stories and features for the domain backlog to enable a continual progression of changes and look for ways to improve efficiency, resilience, reliability, quality and manual inconsistency by increasing the use of automation and virtualisation.
   

  

**Your Responsibilities Will Also Include**
* Supporting environment managers in managing a set of non\-production environments and maintaining non\-production environment dashboards
* Understanding and maintaining a focus on customer value and providing a positive customer experience
* Continually looking for ways to increase speed, efficiency, quality, resilience and reliability by introducing automated and virtualised environments
* Working with environment managers to understand the upcoming flow of work and the customer vision in order to contribute to a fast response to environment related needs
* Working with a range of stakeholders across the bank and third party suppliers to make sure that platform environments are optimised


 The skills you'll need
   

  

 We’re looking for someone with minimum 8\+ years of IT experience in Environment/ Infrastructure management. You should have extensive experience of networking technologies such as LAN, WAN, load balancing and firewalls, ideally including F5 and Fortinet. You’ll also need experience of using observability tools and techniques with the ability to use data, information, and user sentiment to continuously improve solutions.
   

  

**We’ll Also Expect**
* Hands on and In depth experience in AWS \& PCF. Good Knowledge of GCP and Azure
* Cloud Environment management (private \& public) experience including Kubernetes \& Docker with Unix, Postgres , MongoDB familiarity
* Expertise in AWS Networking (VPC, DX\-connect), AWS EKS, EC2 Autoscaling , ECR, AWS SES, SNS, Lambda , API Gateway , and Karpenter
* Familiarity with deployment and configuration of SpringBoot applications in Cloud
* Experience of DevOps practices such as CI/CD pipelines and experience of scripting in Python, Terraform, Ansible, Unix Shell and PowerShell
* Experience of tooling such as Grafana, Prometheus, CloudWatch, Splunk, and ServiceNow
* Strong collaborative communication skills for articulating technical concepts clearly to stakeholders
